'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female Gladiator by the lake with the leaning blue tree. She's not originally from Septimont.
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
;(Only before {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}
:'''Ayla:''' This is truly a remarkable place...
:'''Ayla:''' That Priestess... She's still not here yet.

==Dialogue==
:'''Ayla:''' Excuse me, I was wondering if you've seen a young beautiful Priestess with dark blue hair around here?
:{{DIcon}} You mean… Iuno?
::'''Ayla:''' That's right. Do you know her? Could it be we were destined to cross paths here...?
:{{DIcon}} You can try your luck at Tetragon Temple.
::'''Ayla:''' You are correct, in normal cases. But the Priestess I am looking for is rather unique.
:'''Ayla:''' Her name is Iuno, the most gifted Priestess throughout the history of Septimont.
:'''Ayla:''' I've heard that Priestess Iuno would come here for a walk during her leisure time. So I've decided to try my luck and hope that I can bump into her.
:'''Ayla:''' I am not a Gladiator born from Septimont, so my knowledge of Septimont's Priestesses is rather superficial.
:'''Ayla:''' I was quite skeptical about how the Priestesses are able to perceive the future. But that was before I saw Iuno's prophecy of Septimont's calamity with my own eyes.
:'''Ayla:''' I came here to ask Lady Iuno to look into my fate. See if there's any possibility of realizing my dreams in the future.
:'''Ayla:''' It's rather embarrassing to visit her at Tetragon Temple for a selfish matter like this. I wouldn't want to disturb the other Priestesses at work.
:'''Ayla:''' Since there are rumours of people meeting her here, I will continue to wait patiently for my opportunity... Or perhaps this wait is also part of her prophecy?

==Spoiler for Act VIII: [[By Moon's Fated Light]]==
;After {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}
:;'''Ayla:''' Why do I come here every day?
:;'''Ayla:''' Am I attracted to these views to this extent?
:;'''Ayla:''' Or are there reasons beyond that?
:'''Ayla:''' Graced by moonlight, this tree stands tall, bridging the heavens and the earth. For generations, it has silently watched over the hunting grounds, a steadfast witness to the stories of Septimontians.
:'''Ayla:''' Such magnificence... You share the same sentiment as I do, don't you?
:{{DIcon}} Did you get to see Iuno?
::'''Ayla:''' Iuno? Who may that be?
:{{DIcon}} Did you get your wish fulfilled?
::'''Ayla:''' Strange... Have we met before? And did I mention anything about a wish?
:'''Ayla:''' For some reason, I've been visiting this tree every night ever since I arrived at the hunting grounds.
:'''Ayla:''' Whenever I take in this breathtaking view, a strange sense of loss will always weigh heavily on my heart.
:'''Ayla:''' Am I... am I really here every night just for the view?
:'''Ayla:''' Do you have the same feeling as I do?
:'''Ayla:''' There's always this tingling feeling that I've forgotten something important. And yet I can't for the life of me recall what it was.
----
;After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}
:'''Ayla:''' Several days ago, when I returned to Septimont, I met a strange girl.
:'''Ayla:''' For some reason, I felt like I'd seen her before… but when I thought about it, nothing came to mind...
:'''Ayla:''' She caught me staring and came over to talk. We ended up having a pleasant conversation.
:'''Ayla:''' That's how I made a new friend. Her name is Iuno.
:{{DIcon}} Congrats on fulfilling your wish.
:'''Ayla:''' Haha, that wasn't my wish! But I was genuinely happy to meet her.
:'''Ayla:''' If I get the chance, I'd love to bring her here, to share this beautiful view.
:'''Ayla:''' I'm sure she'd love it.
:'''Ayla:''' Maybe that's the real reason I keep coming back to this tree, to one day bring a friend here.
:'''Ayla:''' …And yet, I can't shake the feeling I've forgotten something important. No matter how hard I try, I just can't recall what it is.
{{Dialogue End}}
